name: Modification 1 Code
definition: Specifies if an item is added, modified, deleted or unchanged.

NOCH.name: No Change
NOCH.definition: Specifies that the item is not changed.

MODI.name: Modification
MODI.definition: Specifies that the item is modified.

DELE.name: Deletion
DELE.definition: Specifies that the item is deleted.

ADDD.name: Addition
ADDD.definition: Specifies that the item is added.
